Here’s a like-for-like comparison. TwixAir does not currently publish a Bali honeymoon package or India-origin package price on its site, so I would treat any quoted TwixAir price as a bespoke quote requiring written confirmation. Its current site mainly advertises flights/travel products and eSIMs. 
TwixAir
+1

Provider	Current price for 2	Exclusions / caveats	Best for
TwixAir LLC	Quote required	No public Bali package price/inclusions; verify flights, hotel, transfers, taxes, TCS/GST, cancellation	Custom itinerary if their quote is competitive
Qutbi Tours	₹1,09,800	4★; verify TCS/GST, exact flights/hotel and cancellation	Value + flights included
One Life Adventure	₹79,000*	TCS/GST, tourism tax, dinners, insurance, tips; price/flight availability can change	Budget honeymoon
Veena World	₹2,86,000	₹1.43L pp; verify airfare/final taxes and tour-date availability	Structured all-inclusive group tour

Qutbi explicitly includes return airfare, hotel, breakfast and private transfers; One Life advertises 6N/7D with flights, transfers and activities, but its page has a pricing inconsistency (“₹79,000 per person” in the heading vs ₹79,000 per couple later), so get the invoice clarified. 
Qutbi Holidays
+1
 Veena World lists its 7-day Honeymoon Special at ₹1.43L/person. 
Veena World

For TwixAir, don't pay until you have a line-item quote showing airfare + baggage, hotel category, private transfers, visa/levy, GST/TCS, cancellation penalties and 24×7 on-trip support.
